Container.Name: Voicebox
Container.Overview:
Voicebox turns plain EPUB books into audiobooks in EPUB 3 Media Overlays format using Azure or Kokoro text-to-speech.
Use the web UI to convert a single book, or drop .epub files into the ingest folder and Voicebox converts them automatically, one at a time. Defaults for automatic conversions are set in the Settings tab and stored in the config folder.
Successfully converted source files are moved to ingest/processed; failures are moved to ingest/failed.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Voicebox web interface.

Config.Name: Ingest Folder
Config.Description: Drop .epub files here to have them converted automatically. Voicebox creates processed/ and failed/ subfolders inside it.

Config.Name: Output Folder
Config.Description: Where the generated audiobooks are written.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Stores settings.json (the automation defaults) and the downloaded Kokoro model. Keep this on appdata so settings and the model survive container updates.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the generated files. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the generated files. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask applied to generated files.

Config.Name: AZURE_TTS_KEY
Config.Description: Azure Speech key. Only needed for the Azure TTS engine - the Kokoro engine runs offline with no credentials.

Config.Name: AZURE_TTS_REGION
Config.Description: Azure Speech region, e.g. eastus. Only needed for the Azure TTS engine.
